description: This file defines the Environment class with helper methods for PHP environment management, including memory limit checks, setting execution time limits, and determining upload size limits.

classes.name: Environment
classes.description: Provides PHP environment helper methods such as memory limit checking, execution time setting, and upload size determination.

methods.name: checkMemoryLimit
methods.description: Checks if the system has sufficient memory for an operation based on required memory and optional memory limit.

methods.name: setTimeLimit
methods.description: Attempts to set the PHP maximum execution time, respecting current settings and availability.

methods.name: getUploadMaxSize
methods.description: Determines the maximum file upload size based on PHP configuration settings.
